object.name: evi.hilbert~
object.description: Hilbert quadrature (phase shift) filter using an 8th order polyphase IIR halfband allpass cascade.
object.discussion: For more information about other reimplementations of MSP filters in evieve, see the 'evieve: msp' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.description: Audio input to be phase shifted.

messages.name: coeffs
messages.digest: In left inlet, messages to evi.hilbert~
messages.description: Sending the symbol 'coeffs' to the abstraction displays the current coefficients of the internal Polyphase IIR Hilbert Allpass Cascade filters in a dictionary window. This has no effect on the abstraction and is pointless other than if someone is interested.
